meta.description: Everything the Energon community references, in one list: Enerbot's clips and the Meme Vault's memes. Every entry is a reference, and kind says which.
meta.usage: Entries with a trigger are what Enerbot answers in Slack: reconstruct a RegExp from trigger.pattern + trigger.flags and test text against it. Memes carry an image in media and a category.
